estimate_note: 20s overhead + 2 * shots * sum(circuit duration + explicitly set repetition delay); heuristic, not guarantee
budget_value_kind: Uncommitted lower bound after reserving caps of known pending jobs; submission checks again.

statistics_plan.comparison: Same-job original baseline; postselected winners additionally need same-layout baseline.
statistics_plan.selection: All new physical data pairs are screened; freeze one winner before two NEW independent confirmation jobs. A screening maximum is not a confirmed advantage.
statistics_plan.scope: All unordered hardware coupling edges, one prescribed orientation per new edge; not all orientations, pulse schedules, or circuit designs.
statistics_plan.batch_controls: Repeat original_baseline and anchor_baseline within every scan job; inspect drift and compare within job.
